prediction_text: Direction: Britain votes to leave. In the referendum of 23 June 2016 the Leave side wins (narrowly), and Britain votes to exit the European Union — a shock result against the February polling that showed 'Stay' ahead, with the large undecided bloc breaking for Leave.
basis:
Input card tradition field: not labelled (no such field); system actually used: Western mundane astrology (national charts).
Basis: the card gives the UK national charts (1066, 1801, 1922) as the working charts and Uranus conjunct Ceres at 23 degrees Aries on referendum day — Uranus on a cardinal angle-point reads as sudden rupture/separation of the national body rather than continuity; the assessment was first published in July 2015 and firmed up in February 2016, i.e. a standing Leave call made before the date was known. Polling in the card favours Stay, so the astrological read is deliberately against the polls; confidence moderated for that reason.
